assign.request: Analyze where this week's Claude token usage went and find the ten cheapest wins to cut spend, plus a weekly pace rule Servex can enforce. Read-only, no building.
steps: find the data sources (spend.json, task.jsonl cost lines, Servex registry, session logs)
rank spend by agent/role/model/task for the last 7 days, find top 10 sinks
find the ten cheapest wins ranked by tokens saved per change
propose a weekly pace rule Servex can enforce

log.msg: Aggregated 88 spend.json + 375 task.jsonl files across 2026-09-25..2026-10-01 ($1,521 total). Top finding: Opus is 70% of spend ($1,058 of $1,521), and $322 of that is Opus running tasks solo with zero sub-agents — the mastermind-relays-not-executes anti-pattern, at scale.

decision.question: How deep to go on Servex registry/session logs vs spend.json+task.jsonl
options: read Servex's own registry/session log files directly
rely on spend.json totals + task.jsonl assign/agent lines, which already carry model, group, agent count and are per-task
decision.why: Brief caps this task at low effort/small budget with no minions; spend.json+task.jsonl already gave a clear, reproducible ranking (same data Servex itself would read), and going further into raw session logs would burn more tokens than the finding is worth for a first pass.

assign.title: Token spend: Opus is 70% of the week, $322 of it solo
assign.outcome:
**What landed:** [report.md](report.md) — a ranked look at 7 days of real spend ($1,521 across 88 spend.json + 375 task.jsonl files).

- [x] where the tokens went: Opus is 70% ($1,058/$1,521); $322 of that is 73 Opus tasks run solo with zero sub-agents
- [x] ten cheapest wins: default-to-Sonnet, masterminds relay instead of build, cap Fable's long servex-mastermind runs, spawn by task:{dir,brief}, prompt-cache readme reads
- [x] a weekly pace rule: daily $ budget per role from live spend.json, downgrade the model one rung when over pace instead of blocking

Read-only, as asked — no code changed. Left for the vscode-mastermind to turn into actual changes.
